dhw.box_title: Buffer Efficiency: Optimal Water Temperature & Horizon Coverage
dhw.reasoning_title: Dispatch Reasoning: Why & To What Temperature?
dhw.night_reasoning_text:
The tank is currently {current_temp}°C. Without heating (grey line), the tank cools to {evening_dip}°C during the evening peak (comfort safely maintained), but drops to {morning_dip}°C by morning due to standing loss and morning showers (below the 40°C comfort floor).

Decision & Target Temperature: To guarantee morning comfort, a night charge to {target_temp}°C is scheduled for {start}–{end} during the cheapest night valley (~€{cost} at off-peak rates, COP ~3.30). Daytime forced heating to 60°C is avoided, saving electricity through much higher COP and 55% less standing loss.
dhw.day_reasoning_text:
The tank is currently {current_temp}°C. Without heating (grey line), the tank cools to {evening_dip}°C during the evening peak (approaching comfort threshold).

Decision & Target Temperature: A targeted charge to {target_temp}°C is scheduled for {start}–{end} ({blend}). This optimal target temperature covers hot water demand and heat loss until the next charging window without requiring a night run. Boosting to 60°C is avoided due to lower COP (2.05) and extra heat loss (savings: ~€{savings}).
dhw.standby_reasoning_text:
The tank is currently {current_temp}°C. Without heating (grey line), the tank remains well above the 40°C comfort threshold both during the evening peak ({evening_dip}°C) and tomorrow morning ({morning_dip}°C).

Decision & Target Temperature: Standby maintained (no heating required). The tank covers the entire horizon until the next cheap charging window on its own buffer.
